title: DD Form 214, Report of Transfer or Discharge (30 November 1965)
citation: U.S. Army, DD Form 214 (Armed Forces of the United States Report of Transfer or Discharge) for Larry Dennis Hunnewell, effective 30 November 1965, U.S. Army Personnel Center, Oakland, California. Family copy, photographed August 2026 and scanned 15 August 2026.
notes: The family's own copy. The identifying numbers on it are kept in the family's private archive, not here. It establishes: induction through the Selective Service at Los Angeles on 28 October 1963; promotion to PFC in June 1964 and to SP4 in May 1965; his specialty, radio teletype operator, after a 15-week Army signal course in 1964; foreign service of 1 year, 1 month and 18 days; the Armed Forces Expeditionary Medal (Vietnam); a last duty assignment with the Army medical command in Japan, at the Camp Zama APO; and honorable separation at Oakland on 30 November 1965. It does not name his unit in Vietnam.
